body.name: I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}
body.construction: Partition the observations deterministically into four folds. On fold one, scan treatment-receipt contrasts over a dyadic cutoff--bandwidth grid whose coarsest relevant bandwidth is proportional to \((\kappa_n/M)^{1/s}\); on fold two, fit one-sided local polynomials on the selected flanks and subtract their worst-case radius-\(M\) bias envelopes; on fold three, minimize the resulting local treatment-contrast loss over the retained cutoff cells; on fold four, invert the bias-aware local-polynomial tests of \(Y-\theta D\) at that fixed center over \(\theta\in\Theta\). Define \(I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}\) as the connected hull of the accepted effect labels.
